title: Notifications
intro: Each channel is saved and tested on its own: an incomplete channel never blocks the other.
internalInfo: Subscribe to topic {topic} on {url} from the ntfy app.
secretKept: Leave empty to keep the current one
tlsHelp: TLS for port 465, STARTTLS for port 587.
testOff: Enable and save this channel to test it.
testUnsaved: Save your changes first: the test uses the saved settings.
testedNtfy: Test notification accepted by the ntfy server.
testedSmtp: Test email accepted by the SMTP server.

field.url: Full HTTPS address, without credentials or parameters (https://ntfy.example.com).
field.topic: Letters, digits, dashes or underscores (64 at most).
field.secret: Required for a new connection or after changing the server, port, encryption or username.
field.host: Server name only, for example mail.example.com.
field.from: Full email address, for example fabcore@example.com (not just the server name).
field.to: Full email address, for example workshop@example.com.

error.notifications-invalid: Settings rejected by the server: check the fields and the password.
error.ntfy-install-required: The internal ntfy server is not installed on this FabCore server.
error.rate: Too many attempts: wait a minute.
error.notifications-failed: The provider refused or did not answer. Check the saved settings.
